verdict.rationale: Cookieless tracking is a fair question for a product-analytics tool, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions cookies, cookieless mode, or consent-banner avoidance. On-device session-replay masking is a different privacy control. Server-side REST track events are only a developer building block, not a documented cookieless capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track product usage without third-party cookies so I can minimize or avoid cookie consent banners
